channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: What Is Inkling 2 Mini? The 20GB Local AI Model
item.description: Thinking Machines' Nov 20 open-weight release packs a 26.4B looped-transformer model into a ~20GB checkpoint aimed at 32GB Apple silicon laptops and DGX Spark boxes, with a 1M-token context window.

item.title: Small AI Models Give Banks a Way to Keep Sensitive Data In-House
item.description: A week of small open-weight releases: Inkling 2 Mini, PrismML’s 5.9GB ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, Sarvam-105B, and Baseten’s decision models, all pitched at running AI on local hardware instead of the cloud.

item.title: openset-llm: 27B LLM on CPU, 8 GB RAM, 17-20 tok/s
item.description: A new MIT-licensed inference engine runs PrismML's ternary 27B model on a CPU-only 8 GB machine at 17-20 tokens per second, built as patches on a llama.cpp fork.

item.title: Foundry VTT 14.371: security-focused stable release ahead of Version 15
item.description: Foundry's last Version 14 stable update fixes a batch of vulnerabilities found through AI-assisted security research, bumps Electron to 45.3.4 and Node.js to 24.22.3/26.13.1, and adds Apple Silicon performance work plus Region and VFX improvements before development moves to Version 15.

item.title: New CPU-only inference engine openset-llm runs a 27B model at 17-20 tok/s on 8 GB RAM
item.description: Open Set Labs' new CPU-only engine runs PrismML's ternary 27B Bonsai-2 model at 17-20 tokens/s in 8 GB of system RAM with no GPU, built on a llama.cpp fork with an OpenAI-compatible API.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: A 26B Looped MoE That Runs on a Laptop — Side-by-Side with Qwen3.8-27B
item.description: A deep dive into Thinking Machines' looped-transformer release, tracing how 48 layer applications per token and NVFP4 weights stack up against Qwen3.8-27B on local hardware.

item.title: Pax: the Pydantic AI coding agent for your terminal
item.description: Pydantic ships Pax, a plugin-based terminal coding agent built on its Harness SDK, as the Harness heads toward a 1.0 release.

item.title: A Local LLM That Fits in 3 QR Codes: llm.asm
item.description: A pure x86-64 assembly inference engine that runs Qwen3-0.6B from a 14KB binary, measured 18-36% faster than llama.cpp on CPU, with a 24KB bootable OS that chats straight after power-on.

item.title: Hill-climbing Inkling 2 Mini inference on one RTX PRO 6000
item.description: An agent-driven tuning sweep lifts Inkling 2 Mini single-user decode from 136 to 190.6 tok/s on one RTX PRO 6000 using vLLM nightly with speculative decoding.

item.title: Pydantic Pax: a terminal coding assistant built on a composable harness SDK
item.description: Pydantic launched Pax on Nov 25, a terminal coding assistant on a reusable harness SDK that separates model choice from execution, positioning it against Codex and Claude Code.

item.title: llm.asm: Qwen3-0.6B inference in 14 KB of pure assembly, plus a bootable 24 KB OS
item.description: A new MIT-licensed project runs Qwen3-0.6B from hand-written x86-64 assembly with no C library or runtime, and boots the same model as its own tiny OS; the writeup checks the speed claims against llama.cpp on one machine.

item.title: llama.cpp b12669: Custom GGUF File Size and Quantization
item.description: llama.cpp's new prerelease lets the quantizer aim for a target GGUF file size or average bits-per-weight instead of a fixed preset.

item.title: WoW Forever News: Blizzard Addresses Lockbox Exploit, Uldaman Loot Removed, New Mounts, and More!
item.description: Blizzard issues an emergency lockbox fix, a Uldaman loot change strands a leveling weapon, and the roundup covers new mounts, PvP guides, and a 200-dwarf march on Orgrimmar.

item.title: The Agent Fits in Six Gigabytes
item.description: Three local-model releases in 48 hours squeeze agentic coding onto ordinary hardware: PrismML's ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B running in 5.9 GB, Inkling 2 Mini's looped 26.4B, and Tencent's self-contained 4B vision model for Apple Silicon, plus a new buying guide for local inference machines.

item.title: PrismML Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B: 27B-class agent model in a 5.9 GB GGUF
item.description: PrismML's Nov 24 ternary update to its 27B Bonsai model keeps the 5.9 GB GGUF footprint while tightening multi-step tool use, with vendor-reported agentic scores near full-precision Qwen3.8-27B.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: 26.4B looped-transformer model in a 20 GB checkpoint, benchmarked against Qwen3.8-27B
item.description: A Nov 23 breakdown of Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini: a 26.4B looped-transformer MoE in a ~20 GB checkpoint, with day-one Ollama and llama.cpp support, benchmark claims against Qwen3.8-27B, and Tinker pricing.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: the local AI model that loops its own layers
item.description: A Nov 23 look at Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini: a 26.4B looped-transformer MoE with a ~20GB checkpoint and NVFP4 weights, and the hardware bar for running it locally — 32GB Apple Silicon or 32GB VRAM.

item.title: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini Puts a Looped 26B Open Model on Your Laptop
item.description: Thinking Machines' 26.4B looped-transformer MoE ships Apache 2.0 with day-0 support in llama.cpp, Ollama and vLLM, and Unsloth GGUF quants that target 16 GB of RAM.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: Open-Weight Local AI Agents
item.description: Thinking Machines' 26.4B looped-transformer model reuses its middle layers three times per token, fitting a ~20GB open-weights model with a 1M-token context on a laptop.

item.title: Pi 1.0 Released, Introducing Enhanced Agent Harness and Pi Durable
item.description: Earendil ships Pi 1.0, a hardened minimal coding-agent harness with Codemode, MCP support, deferred tool loading and cache warming, plus the experimental Pi Durable for long-running agentic apps.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini Explained: How a Looped Transformer Gets More Reasoning Out of a 20GB Model
item.description: A deep dive into Thinking Machines' looped-transformer design: 12 shared layers run three times per token, squeezing agentic-coding strength into a ~20GB open-weights model that runs on a laptop.

item.title: Local Adapters, CLI Harnesses, and Craftsmanship in Agentic Workflows
item.description: A roundup of the week's agent-tooling moves: HF's RL-trained LoRA adapters for Qwen3.8-27B, plus Cline 3.0.75, Codex CLI 0.171, and Crush 0.102 shipping autonomous-execution and TUI updates.

item.title: LookAtMyQuant open-sources compiler that quantizes Qwen3.5-4B to 1.23 GB
item.description: Open-source quantization compiler that sizes codewords by measured output damage, squeezing Qwen3.5-4B to 2.3 bits per weight while keeping most of its exact-answer math ability.

item.title: WoW: Forever Had the Biggest Launch in WoW History. December 9 Decides What It Means
item.description: MMOStats stress-tests Blizzard's 'biggest launch ever' claim against Wikipedia and Twitch attention data, and argues the December 9 raid unlock is the real retention test for the level-60-capped world.

item.title: LookAtMyQuant: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.38 GB, Qwen3.5-4B in 1.23 GB — What the Quantization Compiler Actually Claims
item.description: MIT-licensed LookAtMyQuant compiler squeezes Inkling 2 Mini to 5.38 GB at 1.63 bits per weight, claiming 12x lower KL than Q4_K_M at the same size, though its headline benchmarks are disputed on Hacker News.

item.title: Local Adapters, CLI Harnesses, and Craftsmanship in Agentic Workflows
item.description: Hugging Face shipped RL-trained LoRA adapters for Qwen3.8-27B, while Cline, Codex CLI, and Crush all landed harness updates in the same week.

item.title: amv-runtime 2.9.0
item.description: GPU acceleration runtime for on-device AI on Android phones detects the SoC and installs matching llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and BitNet bundles, running them through Vulkan or OpenCL from Termux.

item.title: Look At My Quant: 12x lower KL than Q4_K_M
item.description: A new open-source quantization compiler measures per-piece compression damage and picks the best code for each, beating Q4_K_M by 12x lower KL divergence at the same file size on Gemma 4 E2B, and shrinking Qwen3.8-27B to 7.2 GB with no math-score loss.

item.title: Thinking Machines Ships Inkling 2 Mini, an Open-Weight Multimodal Model Built for Local Hardware
item.description: Thinking Machines' 26B looped-transformer MoE ships with day-zero Hugging Face and llama.cpp support, a ~20GB footprint, and a 1M-token context for laptop-class local inference.

item.title: LLM Fine-Tuning Techniques (2026): LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA, VeRA & DPO
item.description: A current survey of the fine-tuning stack with the latest releases noted: PEFT 0.21.3 and TRL 1.18.0, both shipped November 13, plus Unsloth and Axolotl versions in use.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: The 26B Model That Thinks Three Times Per Token — and Runs on Your Laptop
item.description: A walkthrough of Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini: a 26.4B open-weights MoE that loops its middle layers three times per token, fits in ~20GB, and leads sub-100B open models on agentic coding benchmarks.

item.title: Cline SDK v0.2.1 and Codex rust-v0.171.0 land agent runtime updates
item.description: Cline ships SDK v0.2.1 with signed artifact publishing and UX verification subagents, while Codex rust-v0.171.0 enables the TUI workspace by default with searchable previews and remote server execution.

item.title: Best Local LLMs in 2026: What You Can Run on a Mac mini, DGX Spark or Server
item.description: Freshly updated ranking of 51 open-weight models by the hardware they need, now including Tencent's Hy4 releases and Inkling 2 Mini scores.

item.title: Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
item.description: Technical rundown of Inkling 2 Mini's looped-transformer design: 24 stored layers reused into 48 passes, 26.4B total with 3.4B active, ~20GB checkpoint, 1M context, and GGUF builds for llama.cpp and Ollama.

item.title: MOC - Agentic Coding: Claude Code v2.1.330 and new harness launches
item.description: Daily agentic-coding digest: Claude Code v2.1.330 ships enterprise sign-in, a built-in chart mod and a 30-day scheduled-task ceiling, plus DreamCoder and the open-source Devin alternative OpenComputer launching.

item.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, a 26B looped transformer that runs locally on laptops
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab's 26.4B-parameter looped MoE ships under Apache 2.0 in a ~20 GB checkpoint, reusing its middle layers three times per token to beat Qwen3.8-27B on agentic coding benchmarks on 32 GB laptops.

item.title: What Is WoW Forever? The World of Warcraft That Stays
item.description: Two weeks after launch, a rundown of what Forever actually is: level-60 cap, rulesets instead of realms, Skyborne elves, and raids unlocking December 9.

item.title: Open-Weight Efficiency: Inkling 2 Mini
item.description: Thinking Machines' 26.4B looped-transformer MoE ships as a ~20GB Apache 2.0 checkpoint that runs offline on a laptop and leads sub-100B open models on agentic coding benchmarks.

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini Is a 26B Open-Weights Model That Runs on Your Laptop
item.description: A walkthrough of Inkling 2 Mini: a 26.4B open-weights model that loops its middle layers three times per token and runs offline on a laptop in about 20GB, with leading sub-100B agentic-coding benchmark scores.

item.title: Hugging Face harness adapters: RL-trained LoRAs tuned per coding agent
item.description: Breakdown of Hugging Face's Nov 20 launch: one RL-trained LoRA adapter per agent harness (pi, OpenCode, Hermes Agent) for Qwen3.8-27B, plus a merged super-adapter, with higher pass rates and fewer tool calls reported in each harness.
